plan.notes: Official GTCC 2025-2026 Catalog [Effective Fall 2025], program A 10 40 T. Header prints 'Course Requirements for Associate in Science in Teacher Preparation (60 Credits)' but the official semester plan sums to 61; plan sum used (61) and the 60/61 mismatch disclosed. UGETC option lists are the catalog's published footnote lists: (2) ECO 251, ECO 252, HIS 111, HIS 112, HIS 131, HIS 132, POL 120, PSY 150, SOC 210; (3) ART 111, ART 114, ART 115, DRA 111, ENG 231, ENG 232, ENG 241, ENG 242, MUS 110, MUS 112, PHI 215, PHI 240; (4) MAT 171, MAT 172, MAT 263, MAT 271, MAT 272; (5) BIO 111/112, CHM 151/152, PHY 151/152, PHY 251/252, or AST 151/151A+BIO 110+GEL 111+PHY 110/110A combos. Catalog notes: if transferring to UNCC take COM 231; Teacher Cadet/Teaching as a Profession HS credit (B or better) may substitute for EDU 187. No TCCNS in NC; no equivalencies invented.
